firmware: ThinkCentre firmware with its own network driver; CM4 worker firmware

takeover.note: I219 keeps a few RX descriptors cached from UEFI's ring (first frames land in UEFI's buffers, dropped) and then reports our buffer k in slot k+3; frames are read from the buffer the write-back names

conclusion: ThinkCentre send cost is gone (3% of the upload); ThinkCentre -> CM4 is now capped near 280 Mbit/s by the CM4's receive path (~40 us per 1.5 KB frame), not by the window
